title: Leaf-Wrapped Turkish Duck Kunefe
description: A smoky, crispy, lacto-vegetarian-friendly Turkish dish featuring duck fat and steamed leaf wraps.; Steamed leaf wraps are filled with crispy duck kunefe, served with a side of turkish salad.

ingredients.name: Kunefe cheese
ingredients.notes: Melting cheese, like mozzarella or cheddar.

instructions: Cut the duck breast into thin slices, about 1/4 inch thick.
In a small bowl, mix together duck fat, parsley, lemon juice, and garlic.
Dip each leaf wrap into the melted duck fat mixture, coating both sides evenly, then sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Wrap each leaf wrap around the duck breast, overlapping them slightly to form a neat package.
Place the wrapped duck breast on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each package.
Drizzle the remaining duck fat mixture over the top of each package.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
While the duck kunefe is baking, prepare the kunefe cheese by melting it in a saucepan over low heat.
Once the duck kunefe is done, remove it from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the crispy duck kunefe filled with melted kunefe cheese alongside a side of Turkish salad.
Reheat the steamed leaf wraps in the oven at 350°F (175°C) for 5-7 minutes or until crispy and warm.
